```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_hierarchy AS (
    -- Base case: all products that have FK-9939 as a direct component in a BOM valid on each order date
    -- We need to find all paths from top-level products down to FK-9939
    -- First, get all BOM lines where component is FK-9939 (direct demand)
    SELECT 
        bom.assembly_id,
        bom.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
        bom.start_date,
        bom.end_date
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    JOIN product p ON bom.component_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'FK-9939'
      AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: find assemblies that contain the intermediate assembly
    SELECT 
        bom.assembly_id,
        bh.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty * bh.total_qty AS total_qty,
        GREATEST(bom.start_date, bh.start_date) AS start_date,
        CASE 
            WHEN bom.end_date IS NULL THEN bh.end_date
            WHEN bh.end_date IS NULL THEN bom.end_date
            ELSE LEAST(bom.end_date, bh.end_date)
        END AS end_date
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    JOIN bom_hierarchy bh ON bom.component_id = bh.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
),
-- Get the product_id for FK-9939
fk_product AS (
    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'FK-9939'
),
-- Direct sales of FK-9939 in Northwest territory in 2024
direct_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.order_qty AS qty
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN customer c ON so.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON COALESCE(so.territory_id, c.territory_id) = st.territory_id
    JOIN fk_product fp ON sol.product_id = fp.product_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Northwest'
      AND so.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND so.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
),
-- Component demand: FK-9939 used in other products sold in Northwest territory in 2024
component_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.order_qty * bh.total_qty AS qty
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN customer c ON so.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON COALESCE(so.territory_id, c.territory_id) = st.territory_id
    JOIN bom_hierarchy bh ON sol.product_id = bh.assembly_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Northwest'
      AND so.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND so.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
      AND so.order_date >= bh.start_date
      AND (bh.end_date IS NULL OR so.order_date <= bh.end_date)
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(qty) FROM direct_sales), 0) + 
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(qty) FROM component_demand), 0) AS total_demand
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all orders from Southwest territory in 2023
southwest_orders AS (
    SELECT so.order_id, so.order_date, sol.product_id, sol.order_qty, p.product_number
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    JOIN customer c ON so.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    JOIN product p ON sol.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Southwest'
      AND so.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < '2024-01-01'
),
-- Recursive BOM expansion: find all paths from products to their components
-- Starting from products that were ordered, expand through BOM valid on order date
bom_expansion AS (
    -- Base case: the ordered products themselves (as potential parents)
    SELECT 
        so.order_id,
        so.order_date,
        so.product_id AS root_product_id,
        so.product_number AS root_product_number,
        so.product_id AS parent_product_id,
        p.product_number AS parent_code,
        CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE) AS path_qty,
        0 AS level
    FROM southwest_orders so
    JOIN product p ON so.product_id = p.product_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: expand to children through valid BOM edges
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_date,
        be.root_product_id,
        be.root_product_number,
        p_child.product_id AS parent_product_id,
        uc.child_code AS parent_code,
        be.path_qty * uc.qty AS path_qty,
        be.level + 1 AS level
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN u_composition uc ON be.parent_code = uc.parent_code
    JOIN product p_parent ON be.parent_code = p_parent.product_number
    JOIN product p_child ON uc.child_code = p_child.product_number
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= be.order_date
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR be.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
      AND p_parent.make_flag = true  -- only expand if parent is manufactured in-house
),
-- Get demand for each root product order, including the product itself and all its components
all_demand AS (
    -- The root products themselves (level 0, direct sales)
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        order_date,
        root_product_id,
        root_product_number,
        product_number AS component_code,
        path_qty * order_qty AS total_qty
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            so.order_id,
            so.order_date,
            so.product_id AS root_product_id,
            so.product_number AS root_product_number,
            so.product_number,
            CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE) AS path_qty,
            so.order_qty
        FROM southwest_orders so
    ) direct
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- The components at all levels
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_date,
        be.root_product_id,
        be.root_product_number,
        be.parent_code AS component_code,
        be.path_qty * so.order_qty AS total_qty
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN southwest_orders so ON be.order_id = so.order_id AND be.root_product_id = so.product_id
    WHERE be.level >= 1
)
-- Sum total demand for 'RW-M928'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), 0) AS total_demand_rw_m928
FROM all_demand
WHERE component_code = 'RW-M928';
```
